caption: The drawing features a single glass container with a lid, depicted in a detailed and realistic manner. The container is elevated on a short, thick stem and a wide, circular base with a crosshatch pattern, suggesting cut glass. The body of the container is rectangular with beveled vertical edges, and the surface is adorned with a repeating pattern of square and diamond-shaped facets, each containing an intricate, star-like design inside. The lid fits snugly on top and has a faceted, almost tented appearance with radiating lines, topped by a finial shaped like a small, ornate knob. The coloring is primarily grey with highlights of white and subtle hints of blue to indicate the transparency and reflective qualities of glass, set against a plain, beige background that provides contrast and focuses attention on the container.
title: Compote
